sources: Microsoft Support: 'Options to optimize gaming performance in Windows 11' (support.microsoft.com/topic/a255f612-2949-4373-a566-ff6f3f474613): Virtual Machine Platform and memory integrity can affect gaming performance in some scenarios and configurations; gamers can turn them off while playing and back on afterwards.
Microsoft Learn: 'DISM Operating System Package (.cab or .msu) Servicing Command-Line Options', /Get-FeatureInfo, /Enable-Feature and /Disable-Feature; exit code 3010 = restart required.
No own measurement, therefore 'Disputed' and only in expert mode. Only changes something if the feature is on (for example after installing WSL 2 or Android apps).
